description: CALL THIS BEFORE PLANNING A MULTI-STEP QUERY. Returns the primitives this platform resolves (condition, trial, registration, identifier, phase, sponsor, modality, molecular target, literature, evidence gap, signal), the crossings between them and which endpoint performs each, plus a fidelity for every node and edge: resolved means stored and keyed, derived means reconstructed at read time and a judgement you own, absent means named by the manifesto and not held here. Optional arguments narrow it to one node or one fidelity. NEXT: get_research_curriculum for what to do with it.

node.description: Return one primitive and its crossings.
